## Overview

Palacio Salvo Atlas is a structured project page rather than a generic article. It should read like a case study with clear sections, context, and outcomes.

## Context / Problem

The challenge was to organize architectural observations, references, and process documentation into a format that remained navigable instead of turning into a loose folder of notes.

## What I Built

I built a visual index that treats the building as both subject matter and organizing device. The project combines references, mapping, and editorial structure so the work can be scanned quickly and expanded later.
